title: Buy Now, Pay Later Apps vs. Credit Cards: The Pros and Cons | WSJ
summary: WSJ explainer compares BNPL and credit cards on approval speed, regulation, and profitability for the companies involved.

assertions.quote: Companies like Affirm, Klarna and Afterpay on the other hand, can approve on the spot and make approvals purchase by purchase
they're not covered by the Truth In Lending Act
There is a risk that credit will be extended to you in a situation where you're not likely to be able to repay
they could borrow from multiple lenders at once since BNPL platforms can't see borrowing activity on other platforms
BNPL as a standalone business is not likely to be successful in the competitive market
